claims.claim: Contract MSA-OAK-2018 names Oakfield Logistics GmbH as its counterparty.
Billing records bill Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Oakfield Logistik GmbH and Oakfield Logistics GmbH are the same legal entity; the 2023 rebrand from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH left Handelsregister number HRB 88421 unchanged.
billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH and contract:MSA-OAK-2018 denote the same legal counterparty.
billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH and contract:MSA-OAK-2018 denote distinct legal counterparties.
Identity between billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH and contract:MSA-OAK-2018 cannot be established and must remain unresolved.

support_claim: The packet documents that MSA-OAK-2018's counterparty Oakfield Logistics GmbH rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH without changing HRB 88421, establishing that the billing referent and the contract counterparty are the same legal entity.
